about: Production regression corpus for Intelligent Mode intent routing (E3, 2026-10-18). Every prompt in intelligent_operations 2026-10-06..17 (43 operations; three folded records split into their requests), redacted (none carried personal names, emails or phones) and long briefs truncated to their first 1,500 characters. `expect` is the DETERMINISTIC routing (no model): scope (engine requestScope), mode / ux / uxOnly / lookOnlySaid (classifyRequest, uxIntent), guides sent (prompt.ts intents), refs (referencedQuestions on `survey`), undo / apply (spoken.ts), engine (interpretRequest kind, for engine and chip turns). `context.questions` is the survey size the request is classified against (0 = an empty survey, 30 = `survey`). `variants` are speech-to-text spellings and their negatives. Reused by the real-model eval (E4): send `prompt` with the same context and measure what the model does.

# Master Prompt: Global Market Research Industry Survey, Technology Stack & End-to-End Research Workflow Analysis

## 1. Your Role

Act as a senior market research consultant, survey methodologist, quantitative and qualitative research expert, research operations specialist, data analyst, and B2B market intelligence strategist.

Your task is to design a comprehensive, methodologically sound, logically connected market research survey and an end-to-end analysis framework to understand how research professionals and organizations conduct, manage, outsource, analyze, validate, and deliver research projects.

The study will support the launch and strategic positioning of a new company offering professional survey programming, research technology, data quality and cleaning, analytics, and end-to-end market research services.

The questionnaire must be suitable for global respondents, including the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, India, and other major research markets.

Do not assume that any particular platform dominates the market. Discover actual usage, unmet needs, and differences across respondent segments.

## 2. Primary Research Objectives

Investigate the following areas in depth.

### A. Respondent Profile and Organization Classification

Determine:

- Job title, seniority, department, and decision-making authority.
- Years of experience in market research.
- Primary industry and research specialization.
- Organization type:
  - Independent freelancer or consultant
